coverage.description: Start at constant-only Lin. Visit original keys in sorted order. Replace key k by sol[k] scaled by its original coefficient if present, otherwise by var(k); each insertion passes through add pruning. Newly introduced keys are not revisited in the same call. unknowns returns keys below LEAF.
